justification: Both surfaces carry schematic incised motifs including circular/disc forms and highly stylised anthropomorphic figures, but that is about as generic as shared iconography gets. A is a single monumental anthropomorphic figure whose body bears a few large concentric-circle and belt-like motifs in a symmetrical, body-centred arrangement, while B is a scattered field of many small repeated boats, quadrupeds and stick-figures with no dominant figure or symmetry.
